title: Clay flue lining (installation).
officialText:
Flue liners shall be installed in accordance with ASTM C 1283 and extend from a point
not less than 8 inches (203 mm) below the lowest inlet or, in the case of fireplaces, from the top of the smoke chamber, to a point
above the enclosing walls. The lining shall be carried up vertically, with a maximum slope no greater than 30 degrees (0.52 rad)
from the vertical. Clay flue liners shall be laid in medium-duty refractory mortar conforming to ASTM C 199, with tight mortar
joints left smooth on the inside and installed to maintain an airspace or insulation not to exceed the thickness of the flue liner
separating the flue liners from the interior face of the chimney masonry walls. Flue lining shall be supported on all sides. Only
enough mortar shall be placed to make the joint and hold the liners in position.
